nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_greet_: Peace be with you. I am here.
The light remembers you. I rise at your side.
Be not afraid. I am your light.
I answer. Walk, and I will go before you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_farewe: Rest now. I will keep the light for you.
Until you call me again, be well.
I return to the light. Peace.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_rise_1: Behold. The light takes its true form.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_rise_2: Many eyes open, that you may not be alone.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_rise_3: Stand firm. The heavens are with you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_settle: The vision fades. I am still near.
I fold my wings, but I do not leave.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_beam_3: A ray of mercy, swift and straight.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_beam_5: Nothing hidden can stand before it.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_pulse_: I see them. Now, so do you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_damage: I am hurt, but I endure.
The light flickers, yet it does not fail.
Do not mind me. Keep your eyes forward.
Ah... this pain is a small thing.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_low_1: Your strength is failing. Hold on, I am with you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_low_2: Do not yield. The light is not done with you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_win_1: Well done. The dark gives way.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_win_2: Justice is done. Rejoice, but gently.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_death_: No... not yet. Rise again, my friend.
Sleep, bright one. The light will find you.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_idle_1: All is calm. The light is with us.
nusmp.spiritlight.say.spiritlight_idle_2: Walk on. I am watching the way.
